photos_upload_ck.name: photos_upload_ck
photos_upload_ck.value: "photos"."uploaded_at" is null or "photos"."storage_key" is not null

stock_quantity_ck.name: stock_quantity_ck
stock_quantity_ck.value: ("stock_entries"."state" = 'quantity' and "stock_entries"."quantity" > 0) or ("stock_entries"."state" = 'zero' and "stock_entries"."quantity" = 0) or ("stock_entries"."state" in ('not_found','not_applicable') and "stock_entries"."quantity" is null)

tastings_time_ck.name: tastings_time_ck
tastings_time_ck.value: ("tastings"."start_time" is null or "tastings"."start_time" ~ '^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$') and ("tastings"."end_time" is null or "tastings"."end_time" ~ '^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$')
